item.title: 'World's largest mazesoba chain restaurant' closes Vancouver location
item.description: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba, the "world's largest mazesoba chain restaurant," has shared that it has closed one of its Vancouver locations.

item.title: Calgary Flames make minor trade with the Dallas Stars
item.description: The Calgary Flames are getting a bit of business done before the Olympic roster freeze kicks in later this week.

item.title: Detached home prices dropped the most in these Calgary areas
item.description: A Calgary housing report revealed that every area in the city recorded a decline in detached home prices compared to this time last year.

item.title: 8 chocolate shops in Calgary to satisfy your sweet tooth
item.description: If you're looking for a sweet gift for your loved ones, Calgary has plenty of delicious chocolate shops to visit.

item.title: 'Twilight' stars are hosting a historic reunion with fans in Vancouver this month
item.description: A unique Twilight experience is coming to Vancouver this month as part of Fan Expo, and fans won't want to miss the "fang-tastic" event.

item.title: Surrey minor hockey player gets attention of Wayne Gretzky after playing Canucks intermission game
item.description: A curious answer from a young Vancouver Canucks fan earned him a surprise phone call and a gift from Wayne Gretzky.

item.title: B.C. Rental Protection Fund surpasses goal, securing 2,200 old affordable rental homes to prevent big rent hikes and redevelopment
item.description: B.C. government's Rental Protection Fund for preventing the loss of affordable secured rental housing has exceeded its original mandate.

item.title: Regular Canada Line service resumes after stalled train causes hours-long delays
item.description: A stalled train has been the cause for some major delays for riders of SkyTrain's Canada Line for over two hours.

item.title: Three-km-long segment of Golden Ears Bridge access road to be widened by TransLink
item.description: TransLink will pursue a widening of a three-km segment of Golden Ears Way north of the Golden Ears Bridge in Maple Ridge.

item.title: Vancouver International Airport achieves all-time historic annual record of 26.9 million passengers in 2025
item.description: Vancouver International Airport (YVR) recorded historic all-time records for passenger and cargo volumes in 2025.
